test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**by**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**By**" is used to indicate the method or means of doing something.
 
• It also indicates the agent performing an action.
 
 
• **For example**: *The book was written by Mark Twain.*
